# HiHatGo!

> HiHatGo! is an Android app (tablets and phones) for learning drums on a real electronic drum kit connected by USB-MIDI. You play along to songs on a 3D note highway or real drum sheet music, practise rudiments and grooves with level ladders, and get every hit judged as early, late or perfect. Free download with a 7-day trial, then a one-time purchase of €9.99 + VAT (full price shown on Google Play). No subscription, no ads.

Key facts:
- Works with any electronic drum kit or pad controller that sends MIDI over USB (Alesis, Roland, Yamaha, Millenium and others); tested with the Alesis Nitro Pro.
- Not a touchscreen drum game: it needs a real e-drum kit.
- Android only. There is no PC, Mac or iPhone version at the moment.
- Plays Paradiddle charts (.rlrr folders and .zip files, e.g. from paradb) and Clone Hero drum charts (folders with notes.chart / notes.mid, and .sng files, e.g. from Enchor).
- Comes with no copyrighted songs: you import your own charts. The Practice page and the beat generator work without songs.
- Price: free download, every feature free for 7 days, then a one-time purchase of €9.99 + VAT (full price shown on Google Play).
- For drummers looking for: Paradiddle on Android or without VR, Clone Hero drums or YARG drums with a real e-drum kit, Guitar Hero drums or Rock Band drums on a real kit, a Rocksmith-style app for drums, an e-drum or MIDI drum game for Android, or a drum practice app like Drumeo or Melodics for e-drums. HiHatGo! plays Paradiddle and Clone Hero charts on your own electronic drum kit. (HiHatGo! is not affiliated with any of these products.)
- Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.drumhero.appv2
- Made by Next stop s. r. o., Bratislava, Slovakia. Contact: hihatgo@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Drum rudiments for beginners – the first 8 to learn and how to practise them](https://hihatgo.com/drum-rudiments.html): The essential drum rudiments for beginners with stickings: single and double stroke rolls, paradiddle, flam, drag, five and six stroke rolls. Plus a simple way to practise them so you actually get faster.
- [HiHatGo! – Learn drums on your electronic drum kit | Android drum trainer](https://hihatgo.com/): Learn to play drums at home on your electronic drum kit. Plug your e-drums into an Android tablet by USB, play along to your Paradiddle and Clone Hero charts like Guitar Hero drums, read drum sheet music, practise rudiments and grooves. 7 days free.
- [How to learn drums at home on an electronic drum kit – a beginner's plan](https://hihatgo.com/learn-drums.html): A practical beginner's guide to learning drums at home on an electronic kit: setting up, holding the sticks, counting, your first rock beat, a 15-minute daily practice plan and the mistakes to avoid.
- [How to read drum sheet music – a simple guide for beginners](https://hihatgo.com/read-drum-sheet-music.html): Learn to read drum notation: where the kick, snare, hi-hat, toms and cymbals sit on the staff, note values and rests, counting 1 e & a, and how to read your first rock beat.
- [Connect an electronic drum kit to an Android tablet (USB-MIDI) – setup guide](https://hihatgo.com/setup.html): How to connect your electronic drum kit to an Android tablet or phone with USB: which cable you need, setting up the pads, fixing latency and hits that feel late, and what to do if the kit isn't found.
- [HiHatGo! tips and tricks – loops, speed trainer, sheet music, practice](https://hihatgo.com/tips.html): Get more out of HiHatGo!: loop the hard parts, use the speed trainer, practise fills, pass the Next level fog test, read drum sheet music, jam to any song and set up your drum kit.
- [HiHatGo! – Privacy policy](https://hihatgo.com/privacy.html): How HiHatGo! handles your data.
- [HiHatGo! – Terms of service](https://hihatgo.com/terms.html): The terms for using HiHatGo!.
